reviews.body: Fraud service is flaky under load, see my inline note.
Logic looks right. One blocker: this needs to go through the shared client.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Please build this on `make_client("fraud", settings.fraud_base_url)` instead of calling `httpx.post` directly. Module-level httpx calls skip our timeouts, request-id propagation and the http_call metrics, which is exactly what bit us on 02-11. See ADR-006.

comments.author: dan
comments.body: Ah, I copied this from an old spike. I thought an explicit `timeout=5.0` was enough. Switching now.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Timeout is only one of the things the shared client does. Rule of thumb: nothing in app/ constructs its own httpx client or imports requests.

comments.author: frank
comments.body: Wrap this in a tenacity `@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(5), wait=wait_exponential())`. Every call to an internal service should have retries with backoff, it's basic resilience.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Please no. Once this moves to make_client it already retries connect errors and 502/503/504 twice with jitter. Adding tenacity on top multiplies it: 3 x 5 = 15 attempts per charge. That's exactly how we got INC-12, the retry storm against the card network in February. One retry layer, and it lives in the client.

comments.author: frank
comments.body: Fair, I didn't know the shared client retried. Withdrawing.

threads.rejection_reason: make_client() already retries; stacking another retry layer caused the INC-12 retry storm.
